item.tib: gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi don gsal bar byed pa'i rnam bshad thar lam gsal byed
item.coloph: zhes gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi don gsal bar byed pa'i rnam bshad thar lam gsal byed ces bya ba 'di ni/ snga gong du don gnyer can gyi slob ma zhang ston pa tshul khrims sogs kyis bskul zhing / yon tan rin po che du ma'i bdag nyid sdom brtson sde snod 'dzin pa chen po bla ma lhun grub pa'i gsung gis kyang yang yang bskul zhing / dus phyis nye bar mtshan brjod par dka' ba 'gro ba'i mgon po sman gong ba (ba'i) gdan sa bshes gnyen dam pa nor bu dbang gi rgyal mtshan gyis bka' yis nan cher bskul ba la brten nas / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dad pa cung zad thob pa'i btsun pa rgyal mtshan mchog legs kyis/ rje smra ba'i seng ge gur zhog pa nas bzung ste/ mnyam med bar thang zhang ston/ 'gro mgon sum ston lha 'bum man chad kyi skyes chen de rnams kyi zhabs kyis bcag pa'i gnas mchog dpal ldan bzang po'i ri la sbyar ba/ yi ge pa ni sde snod rgyud sde kun la 'byang pa'i mtha' bzhi drang srong tshul khrims g.yung drung gis bgyis so/ 'dis kyang kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyu gyur cig/
